Favourites according to Athletics Weekly, we were never out of the first three, but having broken away to the tune of 1:19 found ourselves under severe attack from Aldershot's outstanding international Chris Thompson who gave his team a 5 second advantage going into the last stage.
On his favourite second stage, Richard Ward was on song, his sub-15 bringing us up five places as he was chased all the way by Aldershot's Chris Bolt.
